Peninsula State Park campground in the woods near the shore of Tennison Bay (Green Bay).  --AWH

summary: DNR camping page + Tennison Bay map read; GoingToCamp unread (fees $28-53 unconfirmed). 188 sites, 97 electric (amperage not stated), showers, flush toilets, dump station May-Oct, winter camping with electric. Coastal walk (--AWH) AGREES: loops 170-330 m from the Green Bay shore with only a park road between. Pin is in the campground. Season (year_round, manual) unchanged.
